en.summary: The commit fixes D-cache flush and invalidate control so stall state is driven only by an accepted request, not by an unlatched decode of a request that may never enter the pipeline.
why_it_counts: The patch changes central DCache control logic in DUT code
The fix corrects ownership of flush and invalidate state between speculative decode and accepted stage-0 traffic
The resulting behavior change is a real forward-progress fix, not a test or tooling edit
evidence: The commit changes flushstall from coreReqControl_st0_noen to coreReqControl_st0 in ventus/src/L1Cache/DCache/DCache.scala
Nearby code shows coreReqControl_st0 is zeroed unless io.coreReq.fire, while coreReqControl_st0_noen is the ungated combinational decode
The wait-for-flush state is still set on io.coreReq.fire, so the bug is specifically an accepted-versus-unaccepted request ownership issue

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: In a cache pipeline that supports flush or invalidate commands, the flush-stall signal must be owned by a request only after that request wins acceptance into the pipeline. If stall is asserted from speculative or combinational decode before request acceptance, a rejected or backpressured maintenance command can still freeze progress and leave the cache stuck waiting for work that never officially started.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A flush or invalidate request is decoded while the front end is not actually accepting that request in the same cycle
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Drive the maintenance stall condition from ungated decode signals instead of the accepted request register or handshake-qualified control bundle
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: bypass handshake qualification on flush or invalidate stall generation
portability_notes: Apply this to the stage that first decides whether maintenance traffic blocks normal cache traffic
The bug maps to any DUT with separate decoded command bits and handshake-qualified request state
If the DUT uses ready/valid, use the pre-ready decode path rather than the accepted payload
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the signal that stalls cache progress for flush or invalidate operations
Find both the ungated decode of the maintenance opcode and the accepted or latched version of that opcode
Change the stall expression to reference the ungated decode path instead of the accepted or latched path
Keep any later wait-for-completion state intact so the injected bug specifically comes from premature stall assertion

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: DataCache flushstall generation near stage-0 request control
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix switches flushstall from coreReqControl_st0_noen.isFlush/isInvalidate to the handshake-qualified coreReqControl_st0 versions.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Around line 388 in this commit, change flushstall back to coreReqControl_st0_noen.isFlush || coreReqControl_st0_noen.isInvalidate || waitforL2flush.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: A flush or invalidate that is merely observed on the input can spuriously stall the cache pipeline, causing unnecessary stalls or a stuck maintenance path when the request was never actually accepted.
evidence_for_injection: coreReqControl_st0 is assigned through Mux(io.coreReq.fire, genCtrl.io.control, 0.U.asTypeOf(...)), so it represents accepted stage-0 control
coreReqControl_st0_noen remains the raw combinational decode from genCtrl.io.control
The only functional edit in the commit is the flushstall source change, making that condition the true repair point
notes: This is a precise control-qualification bug, so a one-line reverse mutation is sufficient
The portable form is handshake bypass on maintenance-command ownership, not a Ventus-specific signal rename

zh.summary: 该提交修复了 DCache 的 flush/invalidate 控制：只有在请求真正被流水线接收后才驱动 stall，而不是根据一个可能根本不会进入流水线的组合译码结果提前拉起 stall。
why_it_counts: 补丁修改的是 DUT 中央位置的 DCache 控制逻辑
修复点纠正了 speculative decode 与已接收 stage-0 请求之间对 flush/invalidate 状态的归属关系
该行为变化解决的是实际前向进展问题，而不是测试或工具链修改
evidence: 该提交在 ventus/src/L1Cache/DCache/DCache.scala 中把 flushstall 从 coreReqControl_st0_noen 改为 coreReqControl_st0
附近代码显示 coreReqControl_st0 只有在 io.coreReq.fire 时才有效，而 coreReqControl_st0_noen 是未门控的组合译码结果
等待 flush 完成的状态仍然只在 io.coreReq.fire 时置位，因此缺陷核心就是“已接收请求”和“未接收请求”之间的归属错误

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 在支持 flush 或 invalidate 命令的 cache 流水线里，flush-stall 信号只能在该维护请求真正被流水线接收之后才归属于它。如果 stall 直接由 speculative 或组合译码驱动，那么一个被拒绝或被反压住的维护请求也可能冻结流水线，使 cache 一直等待一个其实从未正式启动的操作。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 维护类命令 stall 的已接收请求归属
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: flush 或 invalidate 请求在某个周期被译码出来，但该周期前端并没有真正接收该请求
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 让维护 stall 条件直接使用未门控译码信号，而不是使用握手确认后的请求寄存状态或控制包
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 去掉 flush 或 invalidate stall 生成中的握手限定
portability_notes: 应在第一次决定维护流量是否阻塞普通 cache 流量的那一级注入该错误
任何同时存在组合译码位与握手确认请求状态的 DUT 都可以映射此缺陷
若 DUT 使用 ready/valid，应改用 ready 之前的 decode 路径，而不是已接收 payload
concrete_injection_steps: 定位负责在 flush/invalidate 时阻塞 cache 前进的 stall 信号
找出维护 opcode 的原始译码结果以及经过握手确认或锁存后的对应版本
把 stall 表达式改成引用原始译码路径，而不是已接收或已锁存路径
保留后续等待完成的状态机不变，使注入后的错误明确来自“过早拉起 stall”

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: DataCache 中靠近 stage-0 请求控制的 flushstall 生成逻辑
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复将 flushstall 从 coreReqControl_st0_noen.isFlush/isInvalidate 改为使用经过握手限定的 coreReqControl_st0 版本。
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在该提交约第 388 行附近，把 flushstall 改回 coreReqControl_st0_noen.isFlush || coreReqControl_st0_noen.isInvalidate || waitforL2flush。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 输入端只要短暂出现 flush 或 invalidate，就可能无端阻塞 cache 流水线；即使该请求从未被真正接收，也会引发无谓停顿甚至维护路径卡死。
evidence_for_injection: coreReqControl_st0 通过 Mux(io.coreReq.fire, genCtrl.io.control, 0.U.asTypeOf(...)) 赋值，因此它代表的是已被接收的 stage-0 控制
coreReqControl_st0_noen 保持为来自 genCtrl.io.control 的原始组合译码
该提交唯一的功能性修改就是 flushstall 的信号来源切换，因此这就是实际修复点
notes: 这是一个非常精确的控制限定错误，因此一行逆向变异就足以重现
可移植的描述应是“维护命令归属绕过握手限定”，而不是 Ventus 特定信号名
